description: This file contains utility functions for handling subpath configurations in a Mattermost server, including generating scripts, updating asset paths, and managing Content Security Policy headers.

methods.name: getSubpathScript
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript snippet to set window.publicPath based on the provided subpath.

methods.name: GetSubpathScriptHash
methods.description: Calculates the SHA256 hash of the subpath script for Content Security Policy purposes.

methods.name: UpdateAssetsSubpathInDir
methods.description: Rewrites asset paths in the specified directory to reflect a new subpath.

methods.name: updateRootFile
methods.description: Updates the root.html file with new subpath references and CSP headers.

methods.name: updateManifestAndCSSFiles
methods.description: Updates manifest.json and CSS files to reflect new asset paths.

methods.name: UpdateAssetsSubpath
methods.description: Wrapper to update assets in the default client directory.

methods.name: UpdateAssetsSubpathFromConfig
methods.description: Updates asset paths based on configuration, skipping in dev, CI, or local testing environments.

methods.name: GetSubpathFromConfig
methods.description: Extracts the subpath from the site URL in the configuration.
